post.meta_title: نوار تیp گوجه‌frangi dar shahrestan orumiyeh; tarahi abiyari
post.meta_description: Rahn ma-ye tarahi abiyari navar-tip bist-santi metri baraye gughe-frangi dar shahrestan orumiyeh. Barasi marahl-e tarahi, nokat-e ejrayi va modiriyat-kheyfi ab pish az nasb.
post.html: اگر در mazar'-e shahrestan-е orumiyeh qasd-e kasht-e gughe-frangi darid, entekhab-e monaseb-tarin ravesh-e abiyari va anjam-e tarahi-yi daghigh yekey az tasim-hay-e kli-yi pish az ejra ast. Navar-tip ba arzi bist santi metri yeki az tajhizat-e parkarbord-e abiyari-ye qatr-e i ast ke mitavanad pasokhgu-ye niyaz-ha-ye abiyari-ye radifi bashad. Dar in maghale nokat-e karbardi-ye morabot be tarah va eje-ye in sams ne marوري mikonim.
